				change_variable = { name = gls_location_count add = 1 }

				change_variable = { name = gls_income_clergy add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_clergy_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_income_burghers add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_burghers_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_income_commoners add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_commoners_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_income_tribesmen add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_tribesmen_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_total_income add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_total_income }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_nobles add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_nobles_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_clergy add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_clergy_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_burghers add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_burghers_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_commoners add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_commoners_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_tribesmen_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_country_base_spending add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_base_spending_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_country_liquid_funds add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_liquid_funds_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_nobles_liquid add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_nobles_liquid_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_nobles_base add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_nobles_base_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_clergy_liquid add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_clergy_liquid_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_clergy_base add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_clergy_base_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_burghers_liquid add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_burghers_liquid_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_burghers_base add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_burghers_base_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_commoners_liquid add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_commoners_liquid_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_commoners_base add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_commoners_base_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_tribesmen_liquid add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_tribesmen_liquid_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_sol_tribesmen_base add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_tribesmen_base_display }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { var:gls_location_count > 0 } set_variable = { name = gls_country_location_avg_scale value = { add = var:gls_location_scale_sum divide = var:gls_location_count } } }
	if = { limit = { var:gls_location_count > 0 } set_variable = { name = gls_country_final_demand_scale_avg value = var:gls_country_location_avg_scale } }
	if = { limit = { var:gls_country_base_spending > 0 } set_variable = { name = gls_country_sol_all value = { value = var:gls_country_liquid_funds divide = var:gls_country_base_spending min = 0 } } }

}
REPLACE:sol_compute_substitute_unit_spending = {
	# Location scope; reuse country-adjusted unit spending within each market.
	# Country/world market refresh invalidates the market-keyed owner map.
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_clergy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_burghers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_laborers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_peasants value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_soldiers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_tribesmen value = 0 }
	owner ?= { save_scope_as = sol_spending_country }
	if = { limit = { exists = market exists = owner }
		market = {
			save_scope_as = sol_location_market
			if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { has_global_variable_map = sol_country_market_spending_owner is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_owner target = scope:sol_location_market } "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_owner|scope:sol_location_market)" = scope:sol_spending_country } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_laborers value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_peasants value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_soldiers value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_tribesmen value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_amber } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_amber } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_amber is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_amber target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_amber|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_amber is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_amber target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_amber|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_beer } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_beer } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_laborers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_peasants add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_soldiers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_beeswax } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_beeswax } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_laborers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_peasants add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_soldiers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_books } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_books } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_books is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_books target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_books|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_books is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_books target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_clergy_books|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }

				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_vanilla is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_vanilla target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_vanilla|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_whaleoil is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_whaleoil target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_whaleoil|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_whaleoil is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_whaleoil target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_clergy_whaleoil|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_whaleoil is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_whaleoil target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_whaleoil|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_whaleoil is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_whaleoil target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_laborers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_laborers_whaleoil|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_whaleoil is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_whaleoil target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_peasants add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_peasants_whaleoil|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_whaleoil is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_whaleoil target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_soldiers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_whaleoil|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				remove_local_variable = sol_sub_effective
				remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_nobles key = scope:sol_location_market }
				add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_nobles key = scope:sol_location_market value = local_var:sol_spending_cache_nobles }
				remove_local_variable = sol_spending_cache_nobles
				remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_clergy key = scope:sol_location_market }
				add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_clergy key = scope:sol_location_market value = local_var:sol_spending_cache_clergy }
				remove_local_variable = sol_spending_cache_clergy
				remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_burghers key = scope:sol_location_market }
				add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_burghers key = scope:sol_location_market value = local_var:sol_spending_cache_burghers }
				remove_local_variable = sol_spending_cache_burghers
				remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_laborers key = scope:sol_location_market }
				add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_laborers key = scope:sol_location_market value = local_var:sol_spending_cache_laborers }
				remove_local_variable = sol_spending_cache_laborers
				remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_peasants key = scope:sol_location_market }
				add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_peasants key = scope:sol_location_market value = local_var:sol_spending_cache_peasants }
				remove_local_variable = sol_spending_cache_peasants
				remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_soldiers key = scope:sol_location_market }
				add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_soldiers key = scope:sol_location_market value = local_var:sol_spending_cache_soldiers }
				remove_local_variable = sol_spending_cache_soldiers
				remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_tribesmen key = scope:sol_location_market }
				add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_tribesmen key = scope:sol_location_market value = local_var:sol_spending_cache_tribesmen }
				remove_local_variable = sol_spending_cache_tribesmen
				remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_owner key = scope:sol_location_market }
				add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_owner key = scope:sol_location_market value = scope:sol_spending_country }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_nobles value = "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_nobles|scope:sol_location_market)" }
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_clergy value = "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_clergy|scope:sol_location_market)" }
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_burghers value = "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_burghers|scope:sol_location_market)" }
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_laborers value = "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_laborers|scope:sol_location_market)" }
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_peasants value = "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_peasants|scope:sol_location_market)" }
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_soldiers value = "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_soldiers|scope:sol_location_market)" }
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_tribesmen value = "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_tribesmen|scope:sol_location_market)" }
	}
}
